definition: A gene encoding JIP3 (c-Jun-amino-terminal kinase-interacting protein 3 / mitogen-activated protein kinase 8-interacting protein 3), an adapter protein involved in the kinesin-1 axonal-transport machinery and JNK signaling regulation, in which heterozygous pathogenic variants cause neurodevelopmental disorder with or without variable brain abnormalities (NEDBA).

source.title: Characterization of a novel inherited splice-site variant in MAPK8IP3 expands the genetic and phenotypic spectrum of neurodevelopmental disorders
source.quote: The MAPK8IP3 gene encodes JIP3, a kinesin-1 adapter protein crucial for axonal transport and JNK signaling pathway regulation. This gene exhibits extreme intolerance to loss-of-function variants. Heterozygous pathogenic MAPK8IP3 variants are linked to a neurodevelopmental disorder with or without variable brain abnormalities (NEDBA).
